title: Top-rated movies
statementMd:
List the three movies with the highest average review rating, best first. Show the title and the average rating rounded to 2 decimals. Break ties by title alphabetically.

Expected columns: `title`, `avg_rating`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Join `movies` to `reviews` and group by movie.
Sort by `AVG(rating) DESC, title` and use `LIMIT 3`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.title, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating
FROM movies m
JOIN reviews r ON r.movie_id = m.id
GROUP BY m.id, m.title
ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) DESC, m.title
LIMIT 3;
```

Aggregating per movie and sorting on the aggregate; the secondary sort key makes the result deterministic.
